name: includecost
tagline: Find the C/C++ headers whose removal would delete the most preprocessed code, proven by dominators
trendOrigin: Trend 3 (a build visualizer for Bun's compile times). Trace viewers show where time went. buildcrit and tracedelta already cover Ninja edges and trace diffs. What those posts keep circling is include bloat in C++ and Zig/C interop, and the question nobody answers exactly: if I cut this one header, how much code leaves every translation unit?
